package rulefixtures

// scenario for persistence_model_contains_http_form_or_uri_tags: Persistence models that are tied to form or URI binding tags.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Product struct {
	ID    int    `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	Name  string `gorm:"column:name" json:"name" form:"name" uri:"name"`
	Price int64  `gorm:"column:price" json:"price" form:"price"`
	SKU   string `gorm:"column:sku" json:"sku" uri:"sku"`
}

type Order struct {
	ID        int    `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"id"`
	UserID    int    `gorm:"column:user_id" json:"user_id" uri:"user-id" form:"user_id"`
	ProductID int    `gorm:"column:product_id" json:"product_id" form:"product_id"`
	Status    string `gorm:"column:status" json:"status" form:"status"`
}

func (Product) TableName() string  { return "products" }
func (Order) TableName() string    { return "orders" }
